concept: Route 53 failover routing: active/passive with health checks
tests: Configuring automatic DNS switchover to a DR endpoint with fast cutover.
expected: Failover routing + a health check on the primary + a low record TTL. Triggers: "active/passive", "automatically only when the primary is unhealthy", "fast cutover".
why_not: Weighted 50/50 sends half the traffic to DR while the primary is healthy; Simple has no health awareness; Geolocation routes by location, not health.
